content_sections.heading: Panjab University Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 1 for Project Associate and 2 for Project Assistant.

content_sections.heading: Panjab University Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Associate: Postgraduate degree in any of the following (or closely related) disciplines, with at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ ST/ PWD): 1. Prior experience in a related project is desirable. Project Assistant: Postgraduate degree in any of the following (or closely related) disciplines, with at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ ST/ PwD): 1. content_sections.heading: Panjab University Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Walk-In-Interview Shortlisting based on eligibility and selection by project-related Selection Committee

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Panjab University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Staff positions at Panjab University?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the Project Staff positions at Panjab University is 08 September 2026. Candidates are advised to report for the walk-in interview on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Staff posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate degree in Economics/Statistics/Data Science, Management/Commerce, Education/Vocational Education/Adult & Continuing Education, Public Policy/Public Administration, or Social Work/Development Studies/Sociology/Psychology.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Project Staff at Panjab University?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for Project Staff positions at Panjab University. These include roles for Project Staff (Associate) and Project Staff (Assistant).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Staff (Associate) position?
faq.answer: The Project Staff (Associate) position offers a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,625 per month. This is a temporary position under the Lead Knowledge Institution (LKI) project.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Staff (Assistant) position?
faq.answer: The Project Staff (Assistant) position offers a consolidated salary of Rs. 26,000 per month. This is a temporary role within the State Support Mission project at Panjab University.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for these positions?
faq.answer: The application mode for these Project Staff positions is Walk-in. Interested candidates need to attend the interview directly on the specified date and time.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Staff recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-In-Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their eligibility and then selected by a project-related Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry their duly filled application form, experience certificates, publications, original degree certificates, transcripts, and self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Panjab University, Chandigarh. The exact venue details should be confirmed from the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limits for these Project Staff positions. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any specific age criteria.
